# What is the cheapest fertilizer program that still hits your nutrient targets?

> Free fertilizer blend optimizer. Enter field acres, the N, P2O5, K2O and S your crop needs and your dealer's price per ton for urea, UAN, anhydrous, DAP, MAP, potash and AMS, and get the least-cost pounds per acre, the field total and what the obvious one-product-per-nutrient plan costs.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
